source: Integrator remediation, not independent review or acceptance.

findings.summary: Remove the unproven directory cleanup call identity from the successor rather than cast U8Directory to accepted const FileInputStream. Delete this new unit and its two proposed declarations; leave the accepted stream definition unchanged.
One CtrResult(unsigned,unsigned char) SDK boundary, canonical header included by its accepted C++ definition, and byte-wide forwarding wrappers all the way through the accepted dispatcher.
Canonical InputSessionContext* and int status, preserving unused owner and the unmodified machine word. Reuse C009 exact source/comment bytes; fresh callee and natural caller witnesses match.
Use the canonical AudioTaskManager returned unadjusted by func_00185de4; remove AudioWorker and declare the stop API in audio_tasks.h.

Canonical unsigned-byte endpoints write the object representation of signed result storage through an explicit unsigned-char view. Signed interpretation is unchanged; the nonmatching unsigned-storage alternative is retained.
InputSessionContext owns active at 0 and StreamMutex at 0x34. The old selected word is that mutex depth, not another owner; the lazy initializer and accepted resetter now use the same canonical type.
HandleManager now has its evidenced mutex prefix and 24-channel vector. Its accepted resetter uses mutex.depth; all three channel consumers use the real owner, with no duplicate owner structs.
MenuItem getter results stay MenuItem pointers. Expose its alternate TextTable and metadata words in the canonical representation and remove unrelated W12c item/action views and casts.
The forwarded data_0023ecf4 value is ItemPageSet*. Its signed variant/group bytes are now exposed in that canonical prefix, replacing the unrelated descriptor type.
ArchiveResourceTable is already the table member type. The helper now reads its canonical file_table_offset and the caller no longer casts it to W12cArchiveTables.

Material interfaces use canonical DisplayPane, including its observed material-bearing +0x13c view. Preserve DisplayVertexPane vertices at +0x150. This is not a claim about every original pane class size.

The common allocation/free prefix is ManagedExpHeap. HeapArena explicitly embeds it, as LockedExpHeap already does; migrate every source caller and field access to the real base member without pointer casts.
SoundSubsystem explicitly contains its master AudioLinearRamp at zero; existing status bytes belong to that prefix. Per-channel AuxFloatRamp remains a distinct shorter value type.

The natural wrapper forwards SharedMemory**; the IPC output now has that canonical pointer-to-pointer type, and the handle output is CtrHandle*. The serialized address is converted once from its IPC word.
Getter results retain W12cSoundDetail and BankInstrumentInfo identities. Complete their observed relative-reference prefixes and remove the unrelated BinaryReferenceBlock view.
Replace the real implicit __aeabi_memcpy4 declaration with its shared void(void*,const void*,size_t) ARM EABI contract in runtime.h. The already proven binding is unchanged.
One file-scope opaque SelectionHintPanel tag prevents distinct prototype-scope identities in selection.h. Its descriptive role remains INFERENCE.

Remove the duplicate private ctrIpcStaticBufferDescriptor implementation and include ctr/ipc.h. This resolves artificial canonical co-inclusion and follows the existing shared helper convention, without changing the command or bytes.

qualifications: Canonical descriptive field/class roles remain INFERENCE where only layout/forwarding is recovered.
All previous non-F01 identity, original-bug, runtime-extension, indirect-call and native-name qualifications remain.
No R1/L1 model or new alias has been adopted; v2/none only.
No full build, suite, prepare, finalize, adoption, history update or push was performed.
